cases.why: every depth-chart rank is a starter, so a third receiver's knee reaches the card as news -- the information overload Mark asked this stage to avoid.
every snapshot counts, so a player demoted weeks ago is still called a starter.
a week with no report yet is written as empty Out and Doubtful lists, which a reader takes for 'nobody hurt'.
the change test compares the wrong ids, so every quarterback is called new and the flag stops meaning anything.
cases.find: changed = bool(last_id) and bool(chosen_id) and last_id != chosen_id

cases.why: a missing injury description is written as NaN, which is not JSON and breaks whatever reads the file.
the team news step loses continue-on-error in the run that locks picks, so an nflverse injury outage fails Thursday's lock run.

cases.why: reading team news before the lock means Thursday's newly locked week is not yet pending, so it goes into Thursday night with no news.

        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
